task_description: Create VehicleHUD plugin for SA-MP Android MonetLoader with classic SA-styled speedometer, transparent background, config-based positioning, state machine visibility, /vhud command system, and reusable gauge rendering library

verification.summary: Both files pass luajit bytecode compilation. SA-style refactor applied: 180-degree semicircle arc, transparent background (no RectFilled in Classic style), white/muted tick marks with subtle red zone at end only, thicker red needle (3.2*s) with larger pivot hub (7.5*s), speed numbers outside arc, drag system removed entirely, position via config sliders and /vhud pos command, HUD renders directly to BackgroundDrawList without imgui window, HideCursor=true for non-interactive HUD.
